description: January 24 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 1, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 24 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the first decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: Personality of a January 24 birthday
paragraphs: An Aquarian with a caretaker's number: January 24 reduces to 6, and that sense of responsibility is expressed through the fixed air sign's interest in community. About four degrees into Aquarius, in the Uranus decan, the person is often pictured organising a neighbourhood group or a shared project, caring for the collective as much as for individuals.

By noon UTC on January 24, the Sun has normally reached roughly 4° of Aquarius. That places the date in the Aquarius decan that astrologers give to Uranus, the first of three. Uranus, the modern ruler of Aquarius, also governs its opening decan, from about January 21 to January 29. This is traditionally the most independent and inventive part of the sign. Late-January birthdays are commonly linked with original thinkers, interested in the future, technology, social change and the freedom to be exactly themselves. Friendship tends to matter as much as romance, sometimes more. Doubled Uranus can bring a contrarian streak and an emotional detachment that others misread as coldness. Their gift is seeing possibilities ahead of the crowd and inviting others along without pressure.

sections.heading: Numerology of the January 24 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same January 24 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: January 24 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 24 is the 24th day of the year. In most years Pisces season is under way by February 19, 26 days after this birthday.

January 24 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 15 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal. January 24 is also the birthday of Frederick II of Prussia (1712), Luis Suárez (1987) and Moon Jae-in (1953).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 24?
faq.answer: January 24 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 24 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 24?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by January 24 in 15 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 24?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a January 24 birthday are Frederick II of Prussia (1712), Luis Suárez (1987) and Moon Jae-in (1953). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
